Activist's Security Demanded Amid Goa Political Allegations

Abhijeet Dipke, representing the CJP (Citizens for Justice and Peace), has demanded security for an assaulted Goa activist and has criticized the Goa government. Dipke also alleged "vote theft" and "political poaching" in Goa, stating "In Goa, They Stole MLAs."
